title: Suggestion: consider extreme weather conditions during the loop operation by using a weather API.
body:
As someone with 10 years of experience living with type 1 diabetes, I can say that extremely hot weather tends to raise my blood sugar levels, as well as those of most of my friends. Maybe a new feature that considers the weather, by using an API from the official meteorological station, could help balance blood sugar levels even on very hot or freezing days.
I'll be very happy to get feedback about my suggestion.
